decisions.reason: As a 2024 module that extends the core practice software and supports the firm's stated push toward more integrated digital workflows, management is likely to continue it because development effort has already been invested and any weak early uptake can still be treated as temporary.

The secure healthcare messaging service is closely tied to regulation-driven digital health infrastructure, was given a dedicated web presence and highlighted as a major update theme, so public commitment and sunk investment make management especially likely to persist with it.
